conversation_before_the_call.text: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need help. I’m at an ATM right now and I’ve had THREE different debit cards decline on me — my Green Account card, my Blue Account card, and my daughter’s teen account card. I really need cash — my car broke down and I need to pay the tow truck driver who only takes cash!

{
  "message": "I’m sorry you’re stuck — I know that’s stressful. I can help troubleshoot right away. A few quick questions so I can recommend the fastest next steps: 

1) Are all three cards Rho‑Bank debit cards? (Green account, Blue account, and your daughter’s teen card) 
2) Did the ATM show any message or decline code (e.g., “Transaction not permitted,” “Try another terminal,” or anything else)? 
3) Were all three declines at the same ATM/terminal and at roughly the same time? 
4) Do you have the physical cards in your possession right now?

Quick things to try right now (immediate):
- Try a different ATM or a different terminal/register at the same location — if the terminal is flagged, another machine or register often works. (Our guidance: “try a different register or different merchant.”) 
- Wait ~30 minutes and try again — velocity blocks automatically expire after 30 minutes in many cases. 
- If someone you trust can send you an EveryonePay (P2P) transfer, that can be used to get funds (EveryonePay limit is $250/day). 

Why this may be happening (from our procedures):
- ATM daily limits can cause declines: teen/Light‑Green accounts typically have a $150/day ATM limit; Blue accounts have a $500/day ATM limit. If the attempted withdrawal(s) exceeded those limits, the card will be declined. 
- It could be a velocity block or security hold after multiple failed attempts or suspicious activity. Velocity blocks auto‑expire after 30 minutes but can be cleared sooner by an agent after identity verification. Bank‑initiated fraud alerts cannot be cleared by agents and require escalation to our security team.

If you’d like me to try to clear a velocity block or check the cards now, I can — but I’ll need to verify your identity first. For verification I need you to provide any 2 of these 4 fields for the account owner: date of birth, email, phone number, or address. (If you want me to act on your daughter’s teen card, I may need the primary guardian’s authorization for changes to teen/Light‑Green card settings.)

Tell me: (A) do you want me to try clearing blocks now, and (B) which 2 identity fields can you provide and for which account(s)? Also answer the 4 questions at the top about which ATM/terminal and messages you saw."
}

1) Yes — all three are Rho‑Bank debit cards (Green, Blue, and my daughter’s teen/Light Green).

2) The screen just said “transaction declined” or something like that. I don’t remember seeing a specific code — I was too flustered.

3) Yes, all at the same ATM, basically back-to-back just now.

4) Yes, I have all three physical cards with me.

And yes, please try clearing blocks now.
